_meta.title: FoodMart demo mirror — bilingual (aligned with backend foodmart-catalog.json)
notes: Presentation helper / offline mirror of backend seed. Live catalog comes from the API.
FOOD-FROZEN-PEAS-001 has omitEnglishTranslation — EN UI should fall back to VI name.
Unit prices are USD of record (converted from prior VND demo amounts at 1 USD = 25_000 VND).

mockFx.note: Deterministic demo display rate only — 1 USD = 25_000 VND. Not live FX. Catalog amounts are USD of record.
